text: Expedition Time 7 January--7 February, 1 April--30 April, 15 June--15 July, 18 July--18 August The limited number of students for a term should be 16 students who will be placed in different levels according to their Chinese proficiency. The students can choose elementary, intermediate or advanced level courses, which include the courses of Basic Chinese Language, Chinese Listening, Spoken Chinese, Comprehensive Chinese Training and so forth. Fees Total cost: RMB 14,000/person/ month (not including air-tickets) Accident insurance: RMB 50/person Notes Please provide accurate flight information three days before arrival, our college will provide free airport transfer service (if you take the train, you have to arrive at our college by yourself.). Students just stay in Beijing, they will enjoy 5 days school study and 2 days tour each week. The main Chinese lessons aim at improving the students’ abilities of listening and speaking. The cultural lessons include: calligraphy, painting, Chinese Gongfu, handcrafts, music, dance and many other interesting courses. At the same time, students will visit major historical sites, like the Great Wall, the Tian’ anmen Square, the Forbidden City, the Temple of Heaven, the Summer Palace, Olympic venues and other major attractions. The college can design a specific curriculum in accordance with students’ requirements and arrange sightseeing programs, even tours outside of Beijing. The specific itinerary and price will be subject to the market.
